limits: Offline candidate only. No played lean, wrist/elbow or device acceptance.
Current source geometry, selected materials/textures, native rest, shared75skin and inverse binds remain immutable.
The exact outer palmar triangle retains its actual blended MCP/hand/metacarpal fields; point/normal are re-registered after each candidate finger pose.
Fixed semantic palmar material patches and all hand-owned stride128vertices drive a bounded coupled solve; full finite-bar checks are reported separately.
Thumb CMC opposition is a distinct explicit local-Y rotation bounded +/-45degrees; its anatomy/art remain reviewable, unaccepted.

Total finger flex starting envelope MCP85/PIP95/DIP80deg comes from normative study averages, not universal maxima; each additional bound subtracts its measured rest signed flex. Source https://www.thieme-connect.com/products/ejournals/pdf/10.1055/s-0044-1788593.pdf Table2. M11 native saved grip inherits uniform1.15rad and is not an independent maximum certificate.
